goal: Extract the nested interface Tailable into a top-level interface to decouple the tailable contract from Tailer implementation.

ops.details: Create a new top-level interface Tailable in org.apache.commons.io.input that contains the methods getRandomAccess, isNewer, lastModifiedFileTime, and size. Remove the nested Tailable interface from Tailer.java. Keep the signatures identical so existing code in Tailer continues to compile against the new top-level interface.
Add necessary imports (java.io.FileNotFoundException, java.io.IOException) and java.nio.file.attribute.FileTime so the new top-level interface is independently compilable.

Update related tests affected by this refactoring block so the configured build command passes. Adjust imports, package references, moved class references, constructors, and assertions only when required. Do not change production behavior through tests.
